procedure.en: Ships factory-calibrated. There is no zero to find: setting 1 is the finest position on the printed 1–40 hopper ring (Operations Manual v1.6 p.5).
procedure.pt-BR: Sai de fábrica calibrado. Não há zero a ser encontrado: a posição 1 é a mais fina do anel impresso de 1 a 40 no reservatório (manual de operação v1.6, p.5).

notes: Baratza's suggested settings are the same table as the Encore's. Honest Coffee Guide's computed slope is about 25.6 µm per setting ((1200 − 200) ÷ 39); that is a particle-size estimate, not burr travel.
